question.text: 'Satpura Opportunities Fund' has 55% of its corpus contributed by investors whose beneficial owners are citizens of countries sharing a land border with India. The fund proposes to make an investment that would result in holding 12% equity (fully-diluted basis) in 'Deccan Logistics Pvt Ltd'. Under SEBI's Specific Due Diligence framework (Oct 2024 Circular) read with Rule 6 of FEMA (Non-Debt Instruments) Rules, 2019:

answer.text: Necessary due diligence per SFA implementation standards must be carried out BEFORE investment; post-investment, if the scheme holds >=10% equity/equity-linked on fully-diluted basis, the investment details must be reported to the Custodian within 30 days in SFA-specified format
No special due diligence is required if the fund is SEBI-registered
Land-border investor scrutiny applies only to FPI investments, not to AIF investments
The threshold is 75% corpus contribution, not 50%

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/AFD/AFD-POD-1/P/CIR/2024/135 dated Oct 8, 2024: if 50% or more of corpus is contributed by investors who are citizens/from/situated in land-bordering countries (China, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Afghanistan, Nepal, Bhutan, Myanmar) OR whose beneficial owners are such — SFA-standard DD must be done PRE-investment; POST-investment, if AIF holds >=10% equity/equity-linked (FD basis) in investee, report to Custodian within 30 days. Rule 6 NDI Rules requires Government approval for such direct investments. **The Trap:** Option B ignores the specific-DD requirement. Option C wrongly scopes to FPIs only. Option D inflates the threshold. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C uniquely tests the land-border framework. XXIV also tests FEMA NDI Rules. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Manager tip: Include a representation in the Contribution Agreement from every LP about their UBO nationality/situs and a contractual right to exclude LPs if specific-DD fails. Maintain a quarterly UBO refresh. Angel Funds use investment-level (not corpus-level) threshold computation per Sep 2025 circular.
